decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a niche specialist line with long procurement cycles, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it on the market costs little.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has a page of its own and fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio, and a single year of results is too early to judge its value, so the option stays open.
The C80-P G2 is a second-generation general interior luminaire that the firm promotes as newly arrived, so it carries low uncertainty and fits the core business.
The firm presents this microprismatic pendant as a flagship of its direction, so it is a strategic option worth further commitment rather than abandonment.
HMI searchlights face substitution by LED and their prospects are uncertain, but holding this marine niche line costs little, so it is kept open for now.
The marine searchlight serves the robust specialist segment with little cost to keep it, and it is too early to see whether its value will be realized.
